credits.title: Hajatan Setan
credits.overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

credits.title: Haunting of Mount Welirang
credits.overview: Five friends camp on Mount Welirang. On their way to the summit, they encounter a Queen and her royal troops. What mysteries lie hidden within Mount Welirang?

credits.title: Gowok: Javanese Kamasutra
credits.overview: Set in 1960s Java, a young Javanese woman betrays her teacher, falls in love and must face dire consequences.

credits.title: Sabar Ini Ujian
credits.overview: Sabar relives the same day and gets the opportunity to alter his ex-girlfriend's wedding ceremony over and over until he gets the girl of his dream.
